rationale: C25 plausibly supplied a material condolence-message template: a formal address to a foreign head of state, an opening invocation of the American government or people, reference to the passing of a distinguished national figure, praise for the deceased's service, and acknowledgment of the foreign country's loss. The child compresses and adapts that machinery to Finland and a former president. C09 has a closely parallel diplomatic-sympathy structure but concerns a natural disaster rather than a death. C06 shares regret, representation of the American people, and praise for distinguished service, but it is a retirement tribute rather than a foreign condolence telegram.

shared_material.child_excerpt: On behalf of the American people and myself I send sincere condolences to both you and the people of Finland
shared_material.parent_excerpt: On behalf of the Government and people of the United States, I wish to convey to Your Excellency's Government and to the people of Honduras, the deep sense of grief
shared_material.explanation: Both use nearly the same representative condolence formula, directing the sentiment to the foreign leader and the leader's people.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the passing of Finland's illustrious former President [Juho Kusti] Paasikivi
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the passing of your Ambassador, General Carlos Izaguirre
shared_material.explanation: Both introduce the death through the same 'the passing of' construction and identify a distinguished public figure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in the loss of President Paasikivi who served his people so well through a difficult period
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Ambassador Izaguirre has fulfilled his mission to this country ably and with distinction. Honduras' great loss in the death of this distinguished citizen
shared_material.explanation: Both combine praise for the deceased's public service with an explicit characterization of the death as the foreign nation's loss.
